headline: You are green for the rehearsal - but the bike leg goes on the Wattbike, because gusts hit 71 km/h by midday.
body:
The drought broke at 18:19 last night and both missing days came back done. Wednesday: Push, then **62 min steady at 132 bpm**, with the 3 x 8 min correctly cut after HRV 53. Thursday: Pull, then **8 km at 6:12/km on 139 bpm**.

Friday's rest paid for itself. HRV **68 against a 60.0 mean** - your first BALANCED morning since **29 August** - and RHR back to 47 from Wednesday's 50. Second straight morning above baseline, so no gate. Take the session as written.

Just not on the road. Gusts run **59 km/h** early and **71** by midday. Wattbike **50 km, roughly 1:50, at 135-145 bpm**, cadence 85-95 - five beats under road because there is no airflow - then straight out for **8 km at 6:30-6:50/km, 150-160 bpm**. Running is care, not no: a headwind, not a hazard. Race kit, race breakfast, race-time wake, full transition.

Sunday stays the sea swim. Gusts drop to **30**, and Monday is 92.

Charge the watch. Two bricks, no run file. And how is the ankle before it carries 8 km?
